description: Where Soheil Router trades. "networks": the EVM networks with our contract (chain id, name, contract, fee, the contracts a trade may call). "otherNetworks": Solana, Bitcoin, TON, Tron, Sui, Hyperliquid, Cosmos networks and the networks paid by deposit, each with its chainId, how its addresses look (type), its coin (nativeToken), the tokens it takes (tokens; null = any), and whether trades can be paid out there (receive), start there (send) or swap there (swap). No API key needed.
name: get_networks
title: Networks
